finding: ClayGraph V3 adds rebuildable, epoch-bound semantic access paths with provenance, admissibility, relation signatures, path rank/weight and build receipts. Accessibility/activation remains derived topology and never truth.
counterhypotheses: Materialized access paths may add stale-state and rebuild overhead without improving retrieval quality versus on-demand bounded graph expansion.
Path-rank heuristics may suppress rare but decisive counterevidence unless benchmarked with explicit counterevidence recall.
required_next_measurement: Compare materialized path fastpath against one-hop dynamic ClayGraph and no-graph baselines under matched context/candidate budgets; include stale-epoch rejection and rebuild-latency measurements.
ancestry_policy: This commit is part of the same V10 semantic-access development lineage as UnifiedDB V10/runtime/preprocessor and is not independent replication.
